import requests, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
exec(open('/dev/null').read()) if False else None
# --- reuse: rebuild minimal pieces ---
B62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1

G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
rows=B62.splitlines(); AAs=rows[0].split(); SC={}
for ln in rows[1:]:
    p=ln.split()
    for j,a in enumerate(AAs): SC[(p[0],a)]=int(p[j+1])
def s_(a,b): return SC.get((a,b),-4)
NEG=-10**9
def gotoh(q,t,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(q),len(t)
    Mp=[0]+[NEG]*m; Xp=[NEG]*(m+1); Yp=[NEG]*(m+1)
    for j in range(1,m+1): Yp[j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    tb=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Mc=[NEG]*(m+1); Xc=[NEG]*(m+1); Yc=[NEG]*(m+1); Xc[0]=go+ge*(i-1)
        rowtb=bytearray(3*(m+1)); qi=q[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a,b,c=Mp[j-1],Xp[j-1],Yp[j-1]
            if a>=b and a>=c: best,k=a,0
            elif b>=c: best,k=b,1
            else: best,k=c,2
            Mc[j]=best+s_(qi,t[j-1]); rowtb[3*j]=k
            a,b=Mp[j]+go, Xp[j]+ge
            if a>=b: Xc[j],rowtb[3*j+1]=a,0
            else: Xc[j],rowtb[3*j+1]=b,1
            a,b=Mc[j-1]+go, Yc[j-1]+ge
            if a>=b: Yc[j],rowtb[3*j+2]=a,0
            else: Yc[j],rowtb[3*j+2]=b,2
        tb.append(rowtb); Mp,Xp,Yp=Mc,Xc,Yc
    fin=[Mp[m],Xp[m],Yp[m]]; st=int(np.argmax(fin))
    i,j=n,m; aq=[];at=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0: aq.append(q[i-1]); at.append(t[j-1]); st=tb[i-1][3*j]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif st==1: aq.append(q[i-1]); at.append('-'); st=tb[i-1][3*j+1]; i-=1
        else: aq.append('-'); at.append(t[j-1]); st=tb[i-1][3*j+2]; j-=1
    while i>0: aq.append(q[i-1]); at.append('-'); i-=1
    while j>0: aq.append('-'); at.append(t[j-1]); j-=1
    return ''.join(aq[::-1]),''.join(at[::-1]),max(fin)
def fasta(a):
    L=requests.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=60).text.splitlines()
    return ''.join(L[1:])
ORTH={'Homo sapiens':'Q9BPU9','Mus musculus':'Q3UK10','Xenopus laevis':'Q6GN70','Danio rerio':'Q6DGZ1',
 'Branchiostoma floridae':'A0A9J7L8S7','Strongylocentrotus purpuratus':'A0A7M7RA54','Schistosoma mansoni':'G4LXE7',
 'Drosophila melanogaster':'M9MRD5','Caenorhabditis elegans':'Q9N423','Trichoplax adhaerens':'B3RKM0',
 'Chlamydomonas reinhardtii':'A8IWR1','Naegleria gruberi':'D2V2P0','Trypanosoma brucei':'Q387L3',
 'Tetrahymena thermophila':'Q22X18','Paramecium tetraurelia':'A0C3F0','Thalassiosira pseudonana':'B5YLQ9'}
hs=fasta('Q9BPU9'); n=len(hs)
col=[[] for _ in range(n)]
for org,acc in ORTH.items():
    s=fasta(acc)
    aq,at,sc=gotoh(hs,s)
    i=0
    for a,b in zip(aq,at):
        if a!='-':
            col[i].append(b if b!='-' else '-'); i+=1
cons=np.array([sum(1 for c in col[i] if c==hs[i])/len(col[i]) for i in range(n)])
# chemical-class conservation
cls={**{c:'acidic' for c in 'DE'},**{c:'basic' for c in 'KRH'},**{c:'polar' for c in 'STNQCY'},
     **{c:'hydroph' for c in 'AVLIMFWG'},'P':'pro','-':'gap'}
clscons=np.array([sum(1 for c in col[i] if cls.get(c)==cls.get(hs[i]))/len(col[i]) for i in range(n)])
print('n orthologues (incl. human):', len(ORTH), ' mean identity to human: %.2f'%cons.mean())
site=[18,20,82,83,84,85,86,87,88,90,19,51,17]   # 1-based residues at/near the superposed Ca2+ site
print('\nConservation at C2 Ca2+-site-equivalent positions (16 ciliated eukaryotes):')
print(f"{'pos':>5s} {'aa':>2s} {'identity':>9s} {'class cons':>10s}  residues observed")
for p in sorted(site):
    i=p-1
    obs=''.join(col[i])
    print(f"{p:5d} {hs[i]:>2s} {cons[i]:9.2f} {clscons[i]:10.2f}  {obs}")
print('\nGenome-wide (whole-protein) mean identity %.2f, median %.2f'%(cons.mean(), np.median(cons)))
siteidx=[p-1 for p in site]
print('Mean identity at Ca2+-site positions: %.2f  (rest of protein %.2f)'%(cons[siteidx].mean(), np.delete(cons,siteidx).mean()))
from scipy import stats
u,pv=stats.mannwhitneyu(cons[siteidx], np.delete(cons,siteidx), alternative='two-sided')
print('Mann-Whitney site vs rest: U=%.0f p=%.3f'%(u,pv))
# most conserved positions overall
order=np.argsort(-cons)
print('\nTop 25 most conserved positions:', ', '.join(f"{hs[i]}{i+1}({cons[i]:.2f})" for i in order[:25]))
np.save('/tmp/cons.npy', cons)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,6.5),sharex=True)
ax[0].bar(np.arange(1,n+1), cons, color='#4a5568', width=0.9)
for p in [20,82,83,84,88]:
    ax[0].bar([p],[cons[p-1]],color='#c53030',width=0.9)
ax[0].set_ylabel('identity to human\n(16 ciliated eukaryotes)')
ax[0].set_title('B9D2 conservation across ciliated eukaryotes; red = positions superposing on the C2 Ca2+ site', fontsize=11)
ax[1].bar(np.arange(1,n+1), clscons, color='#718096', width=0.9)
for p in [20,82,83,84,88]:
    ax[1].bar([p],[clscons[p-1]],color='#c53030',width=0.9)
ax[1].set_ylabel('chemical-class\nconservation'); ax[1].set_xlabel('human B9D2 residue')
for a in ax: a.grid(axis='y',alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
